[attribute-xpointer]
=== `@xpointer` XInclude XPointer

When the attribute <<attribute-parse,`@parse`>> is set to XML (`parse="xml"`), the XPointer contained in this attribute is evaluated to identify a portion of the resource to include. This attribute is optional; when omitted, the entire resource is included. See the W3C XInclude documentation: https://www.w3.org/TR/xinclude/

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-xi-include,`<xi:include>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| XPointer pointing to a portion of a resource.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
